canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; recursively sorted keys; separators comma and colon; ensure_ascii=false; trailing newline excluded

data.fingerprint_method: SHA-256 incremental ORDER BY symbol,date; symbol UTF-8 + NUL + date ASCII + NUL + big-endian IEEE-754 open/high/low/close doubles + signed 64-bit integer volume
data.fingerprint_pending_reason: specification locked before execution; fingerprint recorded fresh at execution time regardless of whether the same data already backs an earlier experiment

indicator.smoothing: Wilder EWM via pandas ewm(alpha=1/period, adjust=False) on clipped gains/losses, identical to backend/app/strategies.py:RsiReversion

placebo.note: self-referential; no external decline-magnitude constant or full-sample calibration

forward_return.definition: R10(t) = sum of log returns over the 10 sessions following the event close

bootstrap.extension_required: event-recomputing variant: resample raw returns in circular blocks, reconstruct a synthetic price path, recompute RSI/event/placebo on the resampled path, then compute mean forward return over resampled events
bootstrap.p_value_convention: one-sided; fraction of resamples with resampled_mean_forward_return >= observed, plus add-one correction

correction.family_definition: 12 assets, event statistic only; placebo compared per-asset, not a second Holm-corrected family

gates.placebo_rule: event mean forward return must exceed placebo mean forward return on the same asset
gates.reproducibility: byte-identical forward-return/p-value artifact on an independent rerun against the same fingerprinted data

multiplicity.parameter_grid: none in this run; single locked RSI(14)/30/70 and single 10-session forward horizon

scope_exclusions.no_costs: out of scope for this no-trade characterization run
scope_exclusions.no_pooled_panel_estimator: per-asset only, consistent with Cycle 2/3 precedent
scope_exclusions.no_book_level_or_executable_expression: any tradeable expression remains a separate, later, separately locked protocol
